planets.name: Kepler-411 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-411 with a 58-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: Kepler-411 d was found in 2018 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around Kepler-411. Its orbit and size follow Sun et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
